features: STQC & BIS-ER CERTIFIED SECURITY: Rest easy knowing your data is safe. Unlike standard IP cameras, the Manomay Protect Pro is STQC and BIS-ER certified, meeting stringent government standards for cybersecurity, data privacy, and hardware reliability.

3MP ULTRA-HD & 360° PAN-TILT COVERAGE: Experience crystal-clear video quality with a 3MP resolution that captures every detail. Control the camera remotely via the app to pan and tilt, eliminating blind spots and providing complete 360-degree surveillance of your room.

SMART AI TRACKING & MOTION ALERTS: Equipped with advanced motion detection, the camera automatically locks onto and tracks moving objects or people within its field of view, while sending real-time instant alerts directly to your smartphone.

FULL-COLOR NIGHT VISION: Say goodbye to grainy, black-and-white night footage. Built-in smart floodlights automatically activate upon detecting motion, delivering vivid, full-color HD video even in pitch-black conditions.

2-WAY AUDIO & SMART HOME INTEGRATION: Communicate seamlessly with family, pets, or delivery personnel using the built-in microphone and high-fidelity speaker. Fully compatible with Amazon Alexa for convenient, hands-free voice control.

FLEXIBLE DUAL STORAGE OPTIONS: Secure your footage your way. Supports local storage via a MicroSD card (up to 256GB, card not included) or encrypted cloud storage for hassle-free backup and playback anytime, anywhere.

SEAMLESS WI-FI CONNECTIVITY & REMOTE ACCESS: Equipped with an upgraded high-gain internal antenna, this camera ensures a stable, hassle-free connection to your 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network. Enjoy zero-lag live streaming, instant playback, and complete remote control from anywhere in the world using your smartphone, tablet, or Echo Show.
